src/App.jsx: * Inner layer that has access to CommentContext.
src/App.jsx: * Handles middle-mouse-click global listener + renders comment UI.
src/App.jsx: */
src/App.jsx:function CommentLayer({ currentPage, panelOpen, setPanelOpen, navigate }) {
src/App.jsx:  const { dispatch, comments, pendingLocateId } = useComments();
src/App.jsx:  // Global middle-mouse-click (button 1) listener
src/App.jsx:  useEffect(() => {
src/App.jsx:    const handleMouseDown = (e) => {
src/App.jsx:      // Only trigger on middle mouse button (button === 1)
src/App.jsx:      if (e.button !== 1) return;
src/App.jsx:      // Ignore clicks on comment system UI itself
src/App.jsx:      if (e.target.closest('.floating-comment-ball, .comment-panel-overlay, .comment-pin, .pin-mode-hint, .ball-menu, .sidebar')) return;
src/App.jsx:      e.preventDefault();
src/App.jsx:      e.stopPropagation();
src/App.jsx:      const target = e.target;
src/App.jsx:      const selector = getElementSelector(target);
src/App.jsx:      const label = getElementLabel(target);
src/App.jsx:      // Highlight the element immediately
src/App.jsx:      if (selector) {
src/App.jsx:        const el = document.querySelector(selector);
src/App.jsx:        if (el) highlightElement(el);
src/App.jsx:      }
src/App.jsx:      // Set pending comment so the panel form is pre-filled
src/App.jsx:      dispatch({
src/App.jsx:        type: 'SET_PENDING_COMMENT',
src/App.jsx:        payload: {
src/App.jsx:          linkedSelector: selector,
src/App.jsx:          linkedLabel: label,
src/App.jsx:          page: currentPage
src/App.jsx:        }
src/App.jsx:      });
src/App.jsx:      // Open the panel
src/App.jsx:      setPanelOpen(true);
src/App.jsx:    };
src/App.jsx:    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleMouseDown, true);
src/App.jsx:    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleMouseDown, true);
src/App.jsx:  }, [currentPage, dispatch, setPanelOpen]);
src/App.jsx:  // Handle cross-page locate: after page changes, execute pending locate
src/App.jsx:  useEffect(() => {
src/App.jsx:    if (!pendingLocateId) return;
src/App.jsx:    const comment = comments.find(c => c.id === pendingLocateId);
src/App.jsx:    if (!comment) {
src/App.jsx:      dispatch({ type: 'CLEAR_PENDING_LOCATE' });
src/App.jsx:      return;
src/App.jsx:    }
src/App.jsx:    // Only execute when we've arrived on the right page
src/App.jsx:    if (comment.page !== currentPage) return;
src/App.jsx:    dispatch({ type: 'CLEAR_PENDING_LOCATE' });
src/App.jsx:    // Wait for the new page's DOM to render
src/App.jsx:    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
src/App.jsx:      if (comment.linkedSelector) {
src/App.jsx:        const el = locateElement(comment.linkedSelector);
src/App.jsx:        if (el) highlightElement(el);
src/App.jsx:      }
src/App.jsx:    }, 500);
src/App.jsx:    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
src/App.jsx:  }, [currentPage, pendingLocateId, comments, dispatch]);
src/App.jsx:  return (
src/App.jsx:    <>
src/App.jsx:      <CommentPin currentPage={currentPage} onCommentClick={() => setPanelOpen(true)} />
src/App.jsx:      <FloatingCommentBall onTogglePanel={() => setPanelOpen(!panelOpen)} panelOpen={panelOpen} />

src/App.jsx:    </>
src/App.jsx:  );
